title: A reopened work order leaves the report until it is closed again
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location has no accounting integration (neither QuickBooks Online nor AccountingHub).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, closed, closed this month.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 2, for internal customer A, closed, closed this month, so a listed row can be compared.
custom_steps:
1. Reopen work order 1 from the Finance tab.
  2. Open Reports > Internal Work Orders.
  3. Set the date range to this month.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 is Complete.

Step 2:

  • The report opens and is still listed.

Step 3:

  • Work order 2 is listed; work order 1 is not.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11766 (Story 9, Reports, dashboard and exports)

  • S9-E1: “A reopened internal or no-charge work order keeps its classification and leaves the Internal Work Orders report until it is closed again; it is never in the money reports. The report, the chip and the export option stay listed (S9-R4).”
